# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c10 P9](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher and university student  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c16 P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Titles:** the 'rose-red' girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a striking, dark-eyed young woman who won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy. She maintains a neat, composed appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart filled with romantic, yearning dreams and imaginations, while also maintaining a practical, thoughtful disposition. She can be somewhat pessimistic or skeptical, especially regarding practical or romantic matters, yet she is prone to fits of laughter and despondency over her studies.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c35 P40](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0040), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014), [v3 c38 P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)_

## Goals

- complete university studies at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>

## History

While studying at Regent's Academy, Mabel became one of Nell Harcourt's close companions, winning the Second Year beauty prize. Following her time at Regent's, she worked as a schoolteacher until deciding to resume her studies at Wexcombe. She proposed renting Tabby's Place in Wexcombe alongside Nell and Honora Hollis, bringing her Aunt Euphemia to handle housekeeping. During her time at university, she managed the household's financial records, struggled through periods of academic exhaustion alongside her roommates, and participated in the literary activities of the Philomathic Society. Upon finishing tests for her final year, she achieved a respectable overall performance at Convocation.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c17 P1](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0001), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
